subject: How to plot multipleGroup class object more flexible ?

messages.author: f89ba2a13a8b7413
messages.subject: How to plot multipleGroup class object more flexible ?
parts:
Dear Phil and the Development team.

I'm now using mirt pkg to analyze multiple group IRT model.
I run `multipleGroup()` without any big problem. So next, I want to visualize population distributions.

I used plot-method and get a graph attached.　I was surprised at how easy to plot.

However, speaking greed, I hope to plot more flexible(e.g. custom legend, splitting plot frame by each group, plot using `ggplot2` pkg...).

For now, I want to know how can I split and plot by each group. Could you please tell me how to do it(or why cannot do it)?
(If you need real data I'm using now, I would upload.Rdata)

Thanks in Advance.


ps
here is my code
-----------------------
plot(multipleGroupObject, type = "empiricalhist", npts = 30, pch = 20, lwd = 3)

-----------------------

messages.subject: Re: How to plot multipleGroup class object more flexible ?
parts:
I have solved by myself!
Thanks.

new code

plt <- plot(fit_mg_after_2009_2, type = "empiricalhist", npts = 30, pch = 20, lwd = 3)
tbl <- tibble(prob = plt$panel.args[[1]]$y,
              theta = plt$panel.args[[1]]$x, 
              group = plt$panel.args.common$groups)
tbl %>% ggplot(aes(x = theta, y = prob, group = group, colour = group))+
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(group~., nrow = 2)
